# Modal live v1 sanitized evidence fixture

This closed fixture projects already-local evidence for one successful Modal
SFT run. `evidence-index.json` declares exactly what was and was not captured.
The observed payloads, authenticated provider terminal record, and completion
manifest are absent. Files below `substitutes/` are tiny synthetic test inputs;
their digests are intentionally different from the observed artifact digests.

No provider was contacted to create this fixture.
